senses.definitionEn: To possess, own, or hold something.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I have two brothers and a dog.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Tengo dos hermanos y un perro.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Successful entrepreneurs often have extensive networks of professional contacts.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Los emprendedores exitosos a menudo tienen amplias redes de contactos profesionales.

senses.contextualHint: como verbo auxiliar para tiempos compuestos
senses.definitionEn: Used with a past participle to form perfect tenses.

graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: They would have arrived earlier if traffic hadn't been so heavy.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Habrían llegado más temprano si el tráfico no hubiera estado tan pesado.

phrasalVerbs.example1: She has a red coat on today.

phrasalVerbs.meaningEs: recuperar algo que se había prestado
phrasalVerbs.example1: Can I have my book back, please?
phrasalVerbs.example2: He finally had his car back after repairs.

senses.contextualHint: pronombre para cosas, animales o situaciones abstractas
senses.definitionEn: Used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, or idea that has already been mentioned.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I bought a new phone, and it works very well.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Compré un teléfono nuevo y funciona muy bien.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Understanding the core problem makes it easier to find a permanent solution.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Comprender el problema central hace que sea más fácil encontrar una solución permanente.

senses.contextualHint: pronombre personal segunda persona (singular y plural)
senses.definitionEn: Used to refer to the person or people being spoken or written to.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: Are you ready to order food?
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: If you wish to succeed in this industry, dedication is mandatory.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Si deseas tener éxito en esta industria, la dedicación es obligatoria.

senses.definitionEn: Used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: My brother is a doctor, and he works at the local hospital.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Mi hermano es médico y trabaja en el hospital local.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Although he was exhausted, he completed the project on time.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Aunque estaba agotado, completó el proyecto a tiempo.

senses.definitionEn: Used to state the purpose of something, a recipient, or a duration of time.
senses.grammarPattern: for + noun / for + period of time

graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: They lived in Madrid for three years before relocating to London.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Vivieron en Madrid durante tres años antes de mudarse a Londres.

senses.definitionEn: Used to refer to two or more people, animals, or things previously mentioned.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: My parents are visiting, and they are staying until Sunday.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Mis padres están de visita y se quedan hasta el domingo.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Scientists published the report once they had verified all the empirical data.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Los científicos publicaron el informe una vez que hubieron verificado todos los datos empíricos.
